title: request_header_change runtime event payload
description: ORZ-CACHE-CONTEXT-COST (2026-08-15, ADR-0010 §3.5 条6): the model-request header (system + tools + config) was first observed (initial) or changed (change) since the previous request of the loop. The header digest is the client-observable prefix-cache key; journaling it makes a prefix-cache miss attributable and lets probe flips be cross-checked against the actual request shape. Messages are NOT part of the header.

change_kind.description: ORZ-CACHE-CONTEXT-COST review fix (2026-08-15, ADR-0010 §3.5 条6): the mechanical「变化原因」— which header component changed when reason=change. Present only with reason=change; probe-flip triggers are additionally attributable via the flip↔header verifier cross-check.
